evals.prompt: Go through my coding-agent sessions from the last two weeks and find what I keep having to correct. For each one, say where the fix should live.
evals.expected_output: Lists repeated corrections with session and project counts, finds rules already written but repeated, routes each to the user's instructions, a project's AGENTS.md, a skill's gotchas or a new skill, copies no secret, and changes no file.

evals.prompt: every correction or prompt is a potential pain point a future skill could help with, review my sessions
evals.expected_output: Separates corrections from new requests, keeps lessons seen in at least three sessions, and names skill candidates. From this repository, 14 October 2026.

evals.prompt: why do I keep telling agents the same things? I wrote it down already
evals.expected_output: Finds where the rule is written and why it did not carry over (the wrong level or wording), and proposes moving it up and deleting the lower copy.
